assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md Required Sections table row: '| Environment / Version | `### **Environment / Version**` | Yes | "Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging." |', plus completeness note: 'The Environment / Version section is present but its content is vague: it contains no version identifier'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' quotes the section, checks three patterns (all 'None'), and concludes: '**No version identifier can be extracted.**' then skips 4.5.3-4.5.5 to 4.5.6.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.6 – Flag gap' rendered comment: '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' and identical text in the ADF body paragraph, posted via jira.add_comment("ACME-511", ...).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md gap comment includes '---' rule followed by 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.14.0.'; ADF body contains a 'rule' node and footnote paragraph with link mark, matching shared/comment-footnote.md format.
